Each season's scoring environment

Source: R/era.R
nhl_league_env.Rd

Every completed NHL regular season since 1917-18: the games each club played, goals and assists per team-game, skaters dressed per team-game and the league save percentage (from 1955-56, when the NHL started counting shots against). nhl_era_adjust() rescales players' seasons by it.

Usage

nhl_league_env(refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

refresh

Rebuild from the API instead of using the shipped table.

Value

A tibble, one row per season.

Details

The table ships with the package, so it works offline; refresh = TRUE rebuilds it from the stats API (three requests a season, so a minute or two), for a season completed since this version.

Examples

env <- nhl_league_env()
env[env$season %in% c(19551956, 19811982, 20252026), ]
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>     season schedule goals_per_game assists_per_game skaters_per_game save_pct
#>      <dbl>    <dbl>          <dbl>            <dbl>            <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 19551956       70           2.53             4.03             15.4    0.919
#> 2 19811982       80           4.01             6.61             16.9    0.873
#> 3 20252026       82           3.08             5.20             18.0    0.896
